name: Shea 佘 Family in China
bio: The Shea family originated from ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山) in Guangdong, China. The family has a long history in the region, with records dating back several generations. The ancestors were primarily involved in agriculture and local trade before some members migrated to Malaya in the early 20th century.

name: Shea Woon Mun

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山),
 Guangdong, China

bio:
Woon Mun migrated to Malaya in the early 1910s, and returned to China a few times. 
 When the China closed its borders, he could not return to Malaya. Woon Mun then moved to Tianjin, China for work. 
 He returned to Malaya in 1958. 
Woon Mun was the younger twin brother of Keng Yat.

name: Tham Yoke Keng
bio:
Yoke Keng was born in Hawaii, USA. 
 She married Woon Mun in ZhongShan China and migrated to Malaya with him. 
 Yoke Keng was known for her strong support of the family.

name: Shea Keng Yat

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山), 
 Guangdong, China

bio: Keng Yat was the elder twin brother of Woon Mun. He migrated to Malaya and subsequently settled with Woon Mun's family in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur.

name: Shea Poh Sum

birth.place:
ZhongShan (中山) (formerly HeongShan 香山),
 Guangdong, China

bio:
Poh Sum was the son of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. He migrated to Malaya with his parents and later part of life settled in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. 
 He was an avid photographer and managed a photography business in downtown Kuala Lumpur. Poh Sum was known for his dedication to family.

name: Lee Mun Kay
bio: Mun Kay was born in Malaya. She married Poh Sum and lived in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

name: Shea Yoke Ling
bio: Yoke Ling was the daughter of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. She was born in Malaya.

name: Shea Kong Yew
bio: Kong Yew was the son of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. He was born in Malaya.

name: Shea Kong Nam
bio: Kong Nam was the son of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. He was born in Malaya.

name: Shea Yoke Lan
bio: Yoke Lan was the daughter of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. She was born in Malaya.

name: Shea Kong Choy (Shea Thean Choy)
bio: Kong Choy was the son of Woon Mun and Yoke Keng. He was born in Malaya.
